testimonials.title: What our
testimonials.subtitle: Verified testimonials from executives who have worked with Alternative

item1.quote: Alternative completely transformed our credit operation. In 6 months we reduced costs by 32% and structured a robust quality system. The team not only consulted, they trained us to be self-sufficient.

item2.quote: We had 15 projects running simultaneously, all with delays. They implemented a structured PMO and today 85% finish on time. It completely changed our execution capacity.

item3.quote: I was skeptical at first about consulting, but the results are undeniable: 40% less time in key operational processes. Our clients notice it, our team is more motivated and productive.

item4.quote: We were going to implement an expensive ERP without fixing our processes first. Alternative stopped us, optimized processes, and then we digitized. They saved us more than $200,000 in software we didn't need.

item5.quote: The knowledge transfer approach is real. They not only left us with optimized processes, they trained us to continue improving without depending on external consultants.
